<?php
$nullable = new class {
    public function __get(?string $incoming) {
        echo $incoming === "12" ? "N_STR;" : "N_BAD;";
        $incoming = false;
        echo $incoming === false ? "N_BOOL;" : "N_BAD_FORMAL;";
        return 17;
    }
};
$union = new class {
    public function __get(int|string $incoming) {
        echo $incoming === "12" ? "U_STR;" : "U_BAD;";
        $incoming = 0;
        echo $incoming === 0 ? "U_INT;" : "U_BAD_FORMAL;";
        return 19;
    }
};
$mixed = new class {
    public function __get(mixed $incoming) {
        echo $incoming === "12" ? "M_STR;" : "M_BAD;";
        $incoming = null;
        echo $incoming === null ? "M_NULL;" : "M_BAD_FORMAL;";
        return 23;
    }
};
$selector = "12";
echo $nullable->$selector;
echo ";";
$union->$selector;
echo $mixed->$selector === 23 ? "M_VALUE;" : "M_BAD_VALUE;";
echo $selector === "12" ? "CALLER;" : "BAD_CALLER;";
echo "DONE;";
